description: Implementation of Windows-specific URL security management using WinINet/IE's security zone manager, including credential policy handling and security manager initialization.

classes.name: URLSecurityManagerWin
classes.description: Windows-specific implementation of URLSecurityManager allowing URL credential policies based on IE security zones.

methods.name: CanUseDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Determines if default credentials can be used for a given URL based on security policies.

methods.name: EnsureSystemSecurityManager
methods.description: Initializes the Windows security manager COM object if not already initialized.
